from scipy.signal import savgol_filter

# T041 is in files[0]
data = files[0]["table"]
x = data["raman_shift_cm-1"]
y = data["intensity"]

# Apply Savitzky-Golay smoothing
# window_length=11, polyorder=3, mode='interp'
y_smoothed = savgol_filter(y, window_length=11, polyorder=3, mode='interp')

# Save the result
saved_path = save_result('T041_smoothed.csv', y_smoothed, raman_shift=x)

# Verify and print summaries for numerical confirmation
print(f"Saved path: {saved_path}")
print(f"Original intensity range: [{y.min():.3f}, {y.max():.3f}]")
print(f"Smoothed intensity range: [{y_smoothed.min():.3f}, {y_smoothed.max():.3f}]")
print(f"Difference (mean abs): {np.mean(np.abs(y - y_smoothed)):.3f}")
